gen.npc.quirk.1: Whistles whenever a plan goes right.
gen.npc.quirk.2: Keeps a pocket full of polished screws.
gen.npc.quirk.3: Names every tool before using it.
gen.npc.quirk.4: Saves the best berry for last.
gen.npc.quirk.7: Cannot pass a sign without straightening it.
gen.npc.quirk.9: Knows exactly where the warmest stone is.
gen.npc.quirk.11: Carries a tiny flag for emergencies.
gen.npc.quirk.13: Refuses to waste a good bit of string.
gen.npc.quirk.17: Keeps a ledger of kind deeds.
gen.npc.quirk.19: Taps a helmet three times before battle.
gen.npc.quirk.22: Never sits with their back to a door.
gen.npc.quirk.24: Can identify a hammer by its ring.
gen.npc.quirk.25: Sends postcards to places never visited.
gen.npc.quirk.29: Carries tea for exactly two people.
gen.npc.quirk.31: Sings to keep pace on long roads.
gen.npc.quirk.33: Has a map for every shortcut.
gen.npc.quirk.34: Keeps a jar of frontier dust.
gen.npc.quirk.37: Knows three names for every cloud.
gen.npc.quirk.38: Hides emergency jam under the bed.
gen.npc.quirk.42: Keeps a pressed leaf in every book.
gen.npc.quirk.46: Carries a spare shoelace for strangers.
gen.npc.quirk.48: Says good morning to the moon.
gen.npc.quirk.49: Keeps a copper coin in each glove.
gen.npc.quirk.50: Fixes clocks that are not broken.
gen.npc.quirk.53: Can nap through a boiler whistle.
gen.npc.quirk.59: Keeps a secret recipe for stew.
gen.npc.quirk.62: Paints tiny stars on tool handles.
gen.npc.quirk.64: Keeps a notebook of odd smells.
gen.npc.quirk.72: Says thank you to every bridge.
gen.npc.quirk.73: Leaves a crumb for the camp crow.
gen.npc.quirk.76: Carries a lucky pebble named Dot.
gen.npc.quirk.78: Makes flower crowns for pack animals.
gen.npc.quirk.79: Records dreams in a field book.
gen.npc.quirk.80: Can tell rain by the kettle hiss.
gen.npc.bio.0: I have seen worse roads, and better breakfasts.
gen.npc.bio.1: Give me a quiet morning and a useful task.
gen.npc.bio.2: The frontier feels kinder when we share the load.
gen.npc.bio.3: I can hear a loose gear from three rooms away.
gen.npc.bio.4: There is always one more ridge worth seeing.
gen.npc.bio.5: A warm lantern makes any ruin feel almost friendly.
gen.npc.bio.6: I learned to mend things before I learned to complain.
gen.npc.bio.7: If the kettle sings, the day cannot be all bad.
gen.npc.backstory.0: {name} grew up among {race} families and learned {skill} from a patient {role}.
gen.npc.backstory.1: After a storm scattered {name}'s old camp, a {race} caravan gave them a place beside the hearth.
gen.npc.backstory.2: {name} followed a half-legible map to the frontier and stayed when the first settlement needed a {role}.
gen.npc.backstory.3: A quiet apprenticeship taught {name} that every broken thing has a story worth hearing.
gen.npc.backstory.4: When the old road closed, {name} chose the long way and found a new home among the settlers.
gen.npc.backstory.5: {name} once traded a treasured keepsake for a tool, then used that tool to help rebuild a village.
gen.enemy.bio: {name} is {epithet}, a tier-{tier} threat whose trophies still smell of the road.
gen.item.flavor.unique: It hums softly when pointed toward forgotten roads.
gen.item.flavor.junk: A battered {noun} of {material}, but still useful in a pinch.
gen.item.flavor.crude: Rough frontier work in {material}; honest, noisy, and serviceable.
gen.item.flavor.rare: A carefully made {noun} that catches the light like a promise.
gen.item.flavor.standard: A dependable {noun} prepared from warm, practical {material}.
